options.name: action
options.description: C(update_proc_mem) updates the processor and memory resources of the partition. C(update_pv) Attach Physical Volumes via Virtual SCSI. C(update_npiv) Attach FC Port. C(update_vod) Attach Virtual Optical Device.

options.name: hmc_auth
options.description: Username and Password credential of the HMC.

options.name: hmc_host
options.description: The IP Address or hostname of the HMC.

options.name: npiv_settings
options.description: List of Virtual Fibre Channel port settings to be configured. This option is valid only for I(update_npiv) action.

options.name: pv_settings
options.description: List of Physical Volumes settings to be configured. This option is valid only for I(update_pv) action.

options.name: system_name
options.description: The name or mtms (machine type model serial) of the managed system.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The maximum time, in minutes, to wait for partition operating system to complete dlpar. This option is valid for following actions I(update_proc_mem), I(update_pv), I(update_npiv) and I(update_vod)

options.name: vm_name
options.description: The name of the powervm partition.

options.name: vod_settings
options.description: List of Virtual optical device settings to be configured. This option is valid only for I(update_vod) action.
